name: Clean Chrome and Edge cache (Windows)
description: Clears the Cache, Code Cache and GPUCache folders of Chrome and Edge for all user profiles, skipping a running browser. Cookies, history and passwords are not touched. Dry run by default.

params.name: dry_run
params.label: Dry run (only report what would happen)
params.description: When true (default) nothing is changed and the script only reports what it would do.

output: Per-folder [DONE]/[DRY-RUN]/[SKIP] lines and total bytes. Exit 0; exit 2 on invalid parameters.
